2607.15660.title: ToolVerse: Unlocking Massive Environments and Long-Horizon Tasks for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
2607.15660.paper_summary: While LLM agents demonstrate strong reasoning abilities in compact and well-defined scenarios, they struggle to maintain robustness and effectiveness when faced with large-scale, diverse, and dynamic real-world environments that demand seamless tool integration. To address this gap, we introduce ToolVerse, a comprehensive framework that scales up agentic RL environments and enables agents to perform complex long-horizon reasoning in Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) tasks. First, ToolVerse automatically builds the massive executable agent training environments from nearly 400 real-world Model Context Protocols (MCPs) that contain about 4500 tools. Second, we propose a task design strategy based on a tool dependency graph, utilizing Dynamic Unlocking Sampling Algorithm to generate long-horizon tasks, and produce GUST (Graph Unlocking Sampling Tasks) dataset. Third, to alleviate the credit assigment problem in long-horizon agentic RL, we propose a fine-grained Turn-Aware Relative Advantage algorithm. We conduct extensive Agentic RL training using ToolVerse and evaluate our framework on serveral agentic benchmarks. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework significantly strengthens LLMs' capabilities in long-horizon tool use, achieving a marked performance boost and showcasing robust reasoning within dynamic environments.
2607.15660.paper_summary_zh: 雖然 LLM 代理在緊湊且明確的情境中展現出強大的推理能力，但在面對需要無縫工具整合的大規模、多樣化和動態的現實環境時，它們卻難以保持穩健性和有效性。為了解決這一問題，我們介紹了 ToolVerse，一個全面的框架，能夠擴展代理強化學習環境，並使代理能夠在工具整合推理（TIR）任務中執行複雜的長期推理。首先，ToolVerse 自動從近 400 個現實世界模型上下文協議（MCP）中構建出龐大的可執行代理訓練環境，這些協議包含約 4500 種工具。其次，我們提出了一種基於工具依賴圖的任務設計策略，利用動態解鎖抽樣算法生成長期任務，並產生 GUST（圖解鎖抽樣任務）數據集。第三，為了緩解長期代理強化學習中的信用分配問題，我們提出了一種細粒度的轉向感知相對優勢算法。我們使用 ToolVerse 進行了廣泛的代理強化學習訓練，並在幾個代理基準上評估了我們的框架。實驗結果表明，我們的框架顯著增強了 LLM 在長期工具使用中的能力，實現了顯著的性能提升，並在動態環境中展示了穩健的推理能力。
